name: mypy
description: Mypy is a static type checker for Python

options.name: --module
options.description: Asks mypy to type check the provided module

options.name: --package
options.description: Asks mypy to type check the provided package

options.name: --command
options.description: Asks mypy to type check the provided string as a program

options.name: --exclude
options.description: A regular expression that matches file names, directory names and paths which mypy should ignore while recursively discovering files to check

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help message and exit

options.name: --verbose
options.description: More verbose messages

options.name: --version
options.description: Show program's version number and exit

options.name: --config-file
options.description: This flag makes mypy read configuration settings from the given file

options.name: --warn-unused-configs
options.description: This flag makes mypy warn about unused [mypy-<pattern>] config file sections

options.name: --explicit-package-bases
options.description: This flag tells mypy that top-level packages will be based in either the current directory, or a member of the MYPYPATH environment variable

options.name: --ignore-missing-imports
options.description: This flag makes mypy ignore all missing imports

options.name: --python-executable
options.description: This flag will have mypy collect type information from PEP561 compliant packages installed for the Python executable EXECUTABLE

options.name: --no-site-packages
options.description: This flag will disable searching for PEP561 compliant packages

options.name: --no-silence-site-packages
options.description: By default, mypy will suppress any error messages generated within PEP561 compliant packages

options.name: --fast-module-lookup
options.description: The default logic used to scan through search paths to resolve imports has a quadratic worse-case behavior in some cases, which is for instance triggered by a large number of folders sharing

options.name: --no-namespace-packages
options.description: This flag disables import discovery of namespace packages (see PEP420)

options.name: --python-version
options.description: This flag will make mypy type check your code as if it were run under Python version X

options.name: --platform
options.description: This flag will make mypy type check your code as if it were run under the given operating system

options.name: --always-true
options.description: This flag will treat all variables named NAME as compile-time constants that are always true

options.name: --always-false
options.description: This flag will treat all variables named NAME as compile-time constants that are always false

options.name: --disallow-any-unimported
options.description: This flag disallows usage of types that come from unfollowed imports (such types become aliases for Any)

options.name: --disallow-any-expr
options.description: This flag disallows all expressions in the module that have type Any

options.name: --disallow-any-decorated
options.description: This flag disallows functions that have Any in their signature after decorator transformation

options.name: --disallow-any-explicit
options.description: This flag disallows explicit Any in type positions such as type annotations and generic type parameters

options.name: --disallow-any-generics
options.description: This flag disallows usage of generic types that do not specify explicit type parameters

options.name: --disallow-subclassing-any
options.description: This flag reports an error whenever a class subclasses a value of type Any

options.name: --disallow-untyped-calls
options.description: This flag reports an error whenever a function with type annotations calls a function defined without annotations

options.name: --untyped-calls-exclude
options.description: This flag allows to selectively disable option--disallow-untyped-calls for functions and methods defined in specific packages, modules, or classes

options.name: --disallow-untyped-defs
options.description: This flag reports an error whenever it encounters a function definition without type annotations or with incomplete type annotations

options.name: --disallow-incomplete-defs
options.description: This flag reports an error whenever it encounters a partly annotated function definition, while still allowing entirely unannotated definitions

options.name: --check-untyped-defs
options.description: This flag is less severe than the previous two options -- it type checks the body of every function, regardless of whether it has type annotations

options.name: --disallow-untyped-decorators
options.description: This flag reports an error whenever a function with type annotations is decorated with a decorator without annotations

options.name: --implicit-optional
options.description: This flag causes mypy to treat arguments with a None default value as having an implicit pydata~typing

options.name: --no-strict-optional
options.description: This flag disables strict checking of pydata~typing

options.name: --warn-redundant-casts
options.description: This flag will make mypy report an error whenever your code uses an unnecessary cast that can safely be removed

options.name: --warn-unused-ignores
options.description: This flag will make mypy report an error whenever your code uses a # type ignore comment on a line that is not actually generating an error message

options.name: --no-warn-no-return
options.description: By default, mypy will generate errors when a function is missing return statements in some execution paths

options.name: --warn-return-any
options.description: This flag causes mypy to generate a warning when returning a value with type Any from a function declared with a non-Any return type

options.name: --warn-unreachable
options.description: This flag will make mypy report an error whenever it encounters code determined to be unreachable or redundant after performing type analysis

options.name: --allow-untyped-globals
options.description: This flag causes mypy to suppress errors caused by not being able to fully infer the types of global and class variables

options.name: --allow-redefinition
options.description: By default, mypy won't allow a variable to be redefined with an unrelated type

options.name: --local-partial-types
options.description: In mypy, the most common cases for partial types are variables initialized using None, but without explicit Optional annotations

options.name: --no-implicit-reexport
options.description: By default, imported values to a module are treated as exported and mypy allows other modules to import them

options.name: --strict-equality
options.description: By default, mypy allows always-false comparisons like 42 == 'no'

options.name: --extra-checks
options.description: This flag enables additional checks that are technically correct but may be impractical in real code

options.name: --strict
options.description: This flag mode enables all optional error checking flags

options.name: --disable-error-code
options.description: This flag allows disabling one or multiple error codes globally

options.name: --enable-error-code
options.description: This flag allows enabling one or multiple error codes globally

options.name: --show-error-context
options.description: This flag will precede all errors with 'note' messages explaining the context of the error

options.name: --show-column-numbers
options.description: This flag will add column offsets to error messages

options.name: --show-error-end
options.description: This flag will make mypy show not just that start position where an error was detected, but also the end position of the relevant expression

options.name: --hide-error-codes
options.description: This flag will hide the error code [<code>] from error messages

options.name: --pretty
options.description: Use visually nicer output in error messages use soft word wrap, show source code snippets, and show error location markers

options.name: --no-color-output
options.description: This flag will disable color output in error messages, enabled by default

options.name: --no-error-summary
options.description: This flag will disable error summary

options.name: --show-absolute-path
options.description: Show absolute paths to files

options.name: --soft-error-limit
options.description: This flag will adjust the limit after which mypy will (sometimes) disable reporting most additional errors

options.name: --no-incremental
options.description: This flag disables incremental mode mypy will no longer reference the cache when re-run

options.name: --cache-dir
options.description: By default, mypy stores all cache data inside of a folder named

options.name: --sqlite-cache
options.description: Use an SQLite_ database to store the cache

options.name: --cache-fine-grained
options.description: Include fine-grained dependency information in the cache for the mypy daemon

options.name: --skip-version-check
options.description: By default, mypy will ignore cache data generated by a different version of mypy

options.name: --skip-cache-mtime-checks
options.description: Skip cache internal consistency checks based on mtime

options.name: --pdb
options.description: This flag will invoke the Python debugger when mypy encounters a fatal error

options.name: --tb
options.description: If set, this flag will display a full traceback when mypy encounters a fatal error

options.name: --raise-exceptions
options.description: Raise exception on fatal error

options.name: --custom-typing-module
options.description: This flag lets you use a custom module as a substitute for the pymodtyping module

options.name: --custom-typeshed-dir
options.description: This flag specifies the directory where mypy looks for standard library typeshed stubs, instead of the typeshed that ships with mypy

options.name: --warn-incomplete-stub
options.description: This flag modifies both the option--disallow-untyped-defs and option--disallow-incomplete-defs flags so they also report errors if stubs in typeshed are missing type annotations or has incomplete annotations

options.name: --shadow-file
options.description: When mypy is asked to type check SOURCE_FILE, this flag makes mypy read from and type check the contents of SHADOW_FILE instead

options.name: --any-exprs-report
options.description: Causes mypy to generate a text file report documenting how many expressions of type Any are present within your codebase

options.name: --cobertura-xml-report
options.description: Causes mypy to generate a Cobertura XML type checking coverage report

options.name: --html-report
options.description: Causes mypy to generate an HTML type checking coverage report

options.name: --linecount-report
options.description: Causes mypy to generate a text file report documenting the functions and lines that are typed and untyped within your codebase

options.name: --linecoverage-report
options.description: Causes mypy to generate a JSON file that maps each source file's absolute filename to a list of line numbers that belong to typed functions in that file

options.name: --lineprecision-report
options.description: Causes mypy to generate a flat text file report with per-module statistics of how many lines are typechecked etc

options.name: --txt-report
options.description: Causes mypy to generate a text file type checking coverage report

options.name: --xml-report
options.description: Causes mypy to generate an XML type checking coverage report

options.name: --install-types
options.description: This flag causes mypy to install known missing stub packages for third-party libraries using pip

options.name: --non-interactive
options.description: When used together with option--install-types <mypy --install-types>, this causes mypy to install all suggested stub packages using pip without asking for confirmation, and then continues to perform type checking using the installed stubs, if some files or modules are provided to type check

options.name: --junit-xml
options.description: Causes mypy to generate a JUnit XML test result document with type checking results

options.name: --find-occurrences
options.description: This flag will make mypy print out all usages of a class member based on static type information

options.name: --scripts-are-modules
options.description: This flag will give command line arguments that appear to be scripts
